lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular spots organized in approximately vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. Individual columns display between three and five distinct nodes of peak intensity.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a localized grid where blobs act as anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a high-intensity luminance on the top edge and a sharp gradient to shadow on the lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density clustering of small-diameter, high-luminance spots on the cephalic region, transitioning to larger, more widely spaced nodes posterior to the branchial region.
